title: 7.11 Outdoors
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Name eight things outdoors and say what color three of them are.
grammar_function: It is a + noun; It is the sea / the beach / the sky; The + noun + is + color.
prerequisite: 2.4 It is a + noun; 2.7 colors; 5.1 The apple is red.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a river., It is the beach. and The sky is blue.
